hero: Human Rights Protection Foundation Pakistan promotes human dignity, justice and transparency through lawful advocacy, public awareness and support for vulnerable communities.
aboutTitle: A Voice for Dignity and Justice
aboutParagraphs: HRPF Pakistan is a non-governmental, non-political public-interest organisation. We promote human rights and stand with vulnerable communities through lawful advocacy, public awareness and support for deserving cases.

Our mission is to protect human dignity and promote transparency, clean water and public health. Our vision is a society where everyone has access to justice, essential services and equal opportunity.
quote: We may not be able to solve every problem, but we can refuse to ignore injustice.
cta: Join HRPF Pakistan in promoting human dignity, access to justice and institutional accountability. Support our work, share a concern or get in touch to explore how you can contribute.

focus.title: Women’s Rights
focus.description: Promoting equal access to justice, education and opportunity, with attention to maternal healthcare.

focus.title: Children’s Rights
focus.description: Advocating against child labour and abuse, and promoting access to education and protection.

focus.title: Access to Justice
focus.description: Supporting deserving cases and advocating for innocent prisoners and fair legal processes.

focus.title: Minority Rights
focus.description: Promoting inclusion, interfaith harmony and respect for human dignity across communities.

focus.title: Education and Awareness
focus.description: Building public awareness of fundamental rights, legal protections and access to essential services.

focus.title: Research and Advocacy
focus.description: Using research, documentation and requests for information to encourage transparent, accountable institutions.

programmeCards.title: Access to Information
programmeCards.summary: HRPF promotes the right to information and lawful engagement with public institutions. This is an area of work described in the Foundation’s mission.
programmeCards.imageAlt: Office meeting from HRPF’s supplied photo archive.

programmeCards.title: Clean Water and Public Health
programmeCards.summary: The Foundation’s mission addresses clean drinking water, pollution and maternal healthcare in underserved communities.
programmeCards.imageAlt: Water channel and surrounding farmland from HRPF’s supplied archive.

programmeCards.title: Human Rights and Legal Advocacy
programmeCards.summary: HRPF supports vulnerable communities and deserving cases through documentation, public awareness and lawful advocacy.
programmeCards.imageAlt: Representatives in a meeting from HRPF’s supplied photo archive.

reportCards.title: Progress Report 2025
reportCards.summary: According to HRPF’s 2025 report, its work included health and environmental awareness, human trafficking and smuggling concerns, and press freedom.
reportCards.imageAlt: HRPF archive photograph accompanying this report overview.

reportCards.title: Progress Report 2024
reportCards.summary: According to HRPF’s 2024 report, its work included access to information, analysis of district crime statistics and overseas Pakistanis’ cases.
reportCards.imageAlt: HRPF archive office meeting photograph accompanying this report overview.

reportCards.title: Performance Report 2022-2023
reportCards.summary: According to HRPF’s 2022–2023 report, its work included access to information, water and sanitation, public health and environmental concerns.
reportCards.imageAlt: Public-awareness event from HRPF’s supplied archive, accompanying this report overview.
